question: Q-W-C2-D4
text: Days of supply by Sales Territory at 2015-12-31. Expected: NULL for every territory, with the reason (non-conformed dimension).
interpretation: Days of supply by Sales Territory at 2015-12-31: Sales Territory is not a conformed dimension of the stock snapshot (SPEC § 6.5, W-C2 CITY = N), so every territory's value is NULL. Lists every territory with sales.
assemble: SELECT sales_territory, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS days_of_supply, 'non-conformed dimension: stock holdings carry no city' AS reason FROM territories WHERE lines > 0 ORDER BY sales_territory
note: SLC WWI Stock has no City table: stock is a separate published data source because a multi-fact model would repeat stock measures across the unrelated City dimension (guide § 3.3). Territories come from the sales data source.
